description: This file defines the TriState class, which represents a three-state boolean value (True, False, Unknown). It includes constructors for initialization from strings and enum states, operator overloads for assignment and comparison, and methods to get and set the state. The class is part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace and is intended for use as a utility type within the project.

classes.name: TriState
classes.description: Represents a three-state boolean with states True, False, and Unknown. Provides constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and methods to manipulate and query the state.

methods.name: TriState()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the state to Unknown.

methods.name: TriState(const TCHAR* text, const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state based on a string input, interpreting 'T', 'F', 'TRUE', 'FALSE', case-insensitive.

methods.name: TriState(EnumState state)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state directly from an EnumState value.

methods.name: operator=(const bool rhs)
methods.description: Assignment operator from a boolean value.

methods.name: Set(bool value)
methods.description: Sets the state to True or False based on the boolean, returns true if the state changed.

methods.name: Set(EnumState value)
methods.description: Sets the state to the specified EnumState, returns true if the state changed.
